fields.description: The part of the OTA's tax line to read: its type, its name, or either.
fields.label: Match On

fields.description: Contains: the words appear in it, in order ("vat" matches "VAT (18%)", not "Private"). Is: it is exactly these words.
fields.label: Match

fields.description: Letters and digits of any script count, and at least one is needed; case, spaces and punctuation are ignored.
fields.label: Text

fields.description: Room tax: billed on the folio with the room when the OTA lists it on top of the price. Ignored: the OTA's own (a fee, a city tax), never billed as the room tax.
fields.label: Counts As
